name: 1-play.jpg
shows: Wave 8 of 10 on the floor of a ruined crystal observatory at night (worn violet flagstones, brass astrolabe rings, broken pillars, crystal clusters, star charts, the Core on a carved dais whose runes light one per wave). An Azure main beam (lit in the colour bar) and its Ember and Verdant Prism branches bounce off brass-socketed mirror shards and strike Shades of several colours. About 11 Shades of five kinds, combo x5, Core 12/12, and the HUD in few words: 'WIN: break THE ECLIPSE after wave 10 · LOSE: the Core shatters', '0 = RUN LOST', '2 WAVES TO THE ECLIPSE', INCOMING ('Drifter x6'), a short event log, 'MATCH COLOUR' with the shape pairs, and the named build. The scene first searches 200 runs for a THE ECLIPSE frame; it falls back to wave 8 when none passes all its framing rules.

name: 2-title.jpg
shows: The title screen over the observatory floor: logo, tagline, 'OBJECTIVE  WIN: break THE ECLIPSE after wave 10 · LOSE: the Core shatters', '10 waves · 6 kinds of Shade · 9 upgrades · a three-phase boss', a live reflected beam show, controls, RULES OF LIGHT opening with 'Match the beam to the Shade's colour', BEST SCORE 28,410 and 'Click to begin'.

name: 3-upgrade.jpg
shows: The moment before the boss: WAVE 9 CLEARED with a large 'NEXT: THE ECLIPSE' preview drawn by the boss's own renderer and its three phases (UMBRA, PENUMBRA, TOTALITY) named one per line, above three upgrade cards with icon, level, effect and how each combines with the build, plus Core, score and YOUR BUILD.

name: 4-results.jpg
shows: VICTORY with THE ECLIPSE drawn small beneath it, dimmed and cracked, then the stats (waves, Shades dispelled, colour accuracy, best combo, time), score 32,925 marked NEW BEST over the previous 28,410, the build taken by name and level, and 'Press R or click to play again'. Below it: 'Lose the Core and the run ends: CORE SHATTERED · press R to try again' (the real defeat screen is ?shot=defeat).
